title: The Book of Luke Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Luke — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
verses.decoded: Many people have tried to write an organized account of the events that have been fully believed among us,

verses.kjv: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
verses.decoded: just as they were passed down to us by those who were eyewitnesses from the beginning and servants of the message;

verses.kjv: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.decoded: I also decided, after carefully studying everything from the start, to write to you in order, most honorable Theophilus,

verses.kjv: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
verses.decoded: so you can be sure of the truth of what you have been taught.

verses.kjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
verses.decoded: During the time when Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest named Zacharias, from the division of Abijah. His wife was from the family of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

verses.kjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
verses.decoded: They were both good people, living blamelessly by following all the Lord's commands and rules.

verses.kjv: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
verses.decoded: But they had no children because Elisabeth could not have any, and they were both old.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,
verses.decoded: One day, while Zacharias was serving as a priest and performing his duties according to his group's schedule,

verses.kjv: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
verses.decoded: it was his turn to burn incense in the Lord's temple, as was the custom for priests.

verses.kjv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
verses.decoded: While the incense was being burned, the whole crowd outside was praying.

verses.kjv: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.decoded: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar where the incense was burned.

verses.kjv: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
verses.decoded: When Zacharias saw the angel, he was startled and afraid.

verses.kjv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
verses.decoded: But the angel said to him, 'Don't be afraid, Zacharias. Your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elisabeth will have a son, and you will name him John.'

verses.kjv: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
verses.decoded: You will be very happy, and many people will celebrate his birth.

verses.kjv: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
verses.decoded: He will be great in the Lord's eyes. He will not drink wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even before he is born.

verses.kjv: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
verses.decoded: He will help many people in Israel turn back to the Lord their God.

verses.kjv: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
verses.decoded: He will come with the spirit and power of Elijah to turn the hearts of parents to their children and to help those who are disobedient become wise, preparing a people ready for the Lord.

verses.kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
verses.decoded: Zacharias asked the angel, 'How can I be sure of this? I am an old man, and my wife is also old.'

verses.kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
verses.decoded: The angel answered, 'I am Gabriel, who stands in God's presence. I have been sent to tell you this good news.'

verses.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
verses.decoded: But now, because you did not believe my words, you will be unable to speak until the day these things happen.

verses.kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
verses.decoded: The people were waiting for Zacharias and wondered why he took so long in the temple.

verses.kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
verses.decoded: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the temple because he made signs to them and stayed silent.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
verses.decoded: When his time of service was finished, he went home.

verses.kjv: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
verses.decoded: After that, his wife Elisabeth became pregnant and stayed hidden for five months, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
verses.decoded: 'The Lord has done this for me. He has taken away my shame among people.'

verses.kjv: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
verses.decoded: In the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent by God to a town in Galilee called Nazareth,

verses.kjv: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
verses.decoded: to a virgin who was engaged to a man named Joseph, from the family of David. The virgin's name was Mary.

verses.kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
verses.decoded: The angel came to her and said, 'Greetings, favored one! The Lord is with you. You are blessed among women.'

verses.kjv: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
verses.decoded: Mary was confused and wondered what this greeting meant.

verses.kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
verses.decoded: The angel said to her, 'Don't be afraid, Mary. You have found favor with God.'

verses.kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
verses.decoded: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his ancestor David.

verses.kjv: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
verses.decoded: He will rule over the people of Jacob forever, and his kingdom will never end.

verses.kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
verses.decoded: Mary asked the angel, 'How can this happen since I am not married?'

verses.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
verses.decoded: The angel answered, 'The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will cover you. So the child you will have will be called the Son of God.'

verses.kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
verses.decoded: Also, your relative Elizabeth has become pregnant in her old age. She is now in her sixth month, even though people said she could not have children.

verses.kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
verses.decoded: Nothing is impossible with God.

verses.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
verses.decoded: Mary said, 'I am the Lord’s servant. Let it happen to me as you have said.' Then the angel left her.

verses.kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
verses.decoded: At that time, Mary got ready and hurried to the hill country to a town in Judah.

verses.kjv: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
verses.decoded: She went into Zechariah’s house and greeted Elizabeth.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
verses.decoded: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby inside her jumped, and she was filled with the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
verses.decoded: She spoke loudly, 'You are blessed among women, and the child you will have is blessed.'

verses.kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
verses.decoded: She asked, 'Why am I so honored that the mother of my Lord comes to visit me?'

verses.kjv: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
verses.decoded: As soon as I heard your greeting, the baby in my womb jumped for joy.

verses.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
verses.decoded: Happy are you who believed that what the Lord told you will happen.

verses.kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
verses.decoded: Mary said, 'My soul praises the Lord,

verses.kjv: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
verses.decoded: and my spirit is happy because of God my Savior.

verses.kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
verses.decoded: He has noticed how humble I am, and from now on, everyone will call me blessed.

verses.kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
verses.decoded: The powerful Lord has done great things for me, and his name is holy.

verses.kjv: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
verses.decoded: His mercy continues forever for those who respect him.

verses.kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
verses.decoded: He has shown his strength and scattered those who are proud in their thoughts.

verses.kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
verses.decoded: He has brought down rulers from their thrones and lifted up the humble.

verses.kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
verses.decoded: He has filled the hungry with good things but sent the rich away empty.

verses.kjv: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
verses.decoded: He has helped his servant Israel, remembering his mercy,

verses.kjv: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
verses.decoded: just as he promised to our ancestors, to Abraham and his descendants forever.'

verses.kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
verses.decoded: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home.

verses.kjv: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
verses.decoded: When Elizabeth’s time to give birth came, she had a son.

verses.kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
verses.decoded: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they were happy with her.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
verses.decoded: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the baby and wanted to name him Zechariah after his father.

verses.kjv: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
verses.decoded: But his mother said, 'No, he will be called John.'

verses.kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
verses.decoded: They said to her, 'No one in your family has that name.'

verses.kjv: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
verses.decoded: They made signs to his father to ask what he wanted to name the child.

verses.kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
verses.decoded: He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, 'His name is John.' Everyone was amazed.

verses.kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
verses.decoded: Immediately his mouth was opened, his tongue was freed, and he spoke, praising God.

verses.kjv: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.
verses.decoded: Fear came on everyone living nearby, and all these events were spread throughout the hill country of Judea.

verses.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
verses.decoded: Everyone who heard them kept thinking about them, asking, 'What kind of child will this be?' The Lord’s power was with him.

verses.kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
verses.decoded: His father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke a prophecy:

verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
verses.decoded: Praise the Lord God of Israel, because he has come to help and save his people.

verses.kjv: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
verses.decoded: He has raised up a strong savior for us from the family of his servant David.

verses.kjv: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
verses.decoded: This is what he promised through the words of his holy prophets, spoken long ago.

verses.kjv: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
verses.decoded: He saves us from our enemies and from those who hate us.

verses.kjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
verses.decoded: He shows mercy to our ancestors and remembers his holy agreement.

verses.kjv: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
verses.decoded: The promise he made to our ancestor Abraham.

verses.kjv: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
verses.decoded: He promised that we would be saved from our enemies so we could serve him without fear.

verses.kjv: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
verses.decoded: We will live in holiness and righteousness before him all our lives.

verses.kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
verses.decoded: And you, child, will be called the prophet of the Most High because you will prepare the way for the Lord.

verses.kjv: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
verses.decoded: You will give his people knowledge of salvation by forgiving their sins.

verses.kjv: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
verses.decoded: This is because of the tender mercy of our God, who has sent a light from heaven to visit us.

verses.kjv: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
verses.decoded: This light will guide those living in darkness and in the shadow of death, leading us to peace.

verses.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
verses.decoded: The child grew strong in spirit and lived in the wilderness until the day he began his work in Israel.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
verses.decoded: At that time, Caesar Augustus issued a decree that everyone in the world should be registered for a tax.

verses.kjv: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
verses.decoded: This registration was the first one made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

verses.kjv: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
verses.decoded: Everyone went to their own town to be registered.

verses.kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
verses.decoded: Joseph also went up from Galilee, from the town of Nazareth, to Judea, to the city of David called Bethlehem, because he belonged to the family and line of David.

verses.kjv: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
verses.decoded: He went there to be registered with Mary, his fiancée, who was pregnant.

verses.kjv: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
verses.decoded: While they were there, the time came for her to give birth.

verses.kjv: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.decoded: She gave birth to her first son, wrapped him in cloths, and laid him in a feeding trough because there was no room for them in the inn.

verses.kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
verses.decoded: In the same area, there were shepherds living in the fields, watching their sheep at night.

verses.kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
verses.decoded: Suddenly, the angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them. They were very afraid.

verses.kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
verses.decoded: The angel said to them, 'Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will bring great joy to all people.'

verses.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
verses.decoded: 'Today, in the city of David, a Savior has been born for you. He is the Messiah, the Lord.'

verses.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
verses.decoded: 'This will be a sign for you: you will find a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a feeding trough.'

verses.kjv: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
verses.decoded: Suddenly, a large group of angels appeared with the first angel, praising God and saying,

verses.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
verses.decoded: 'Glory to God in the highest heaven, and peace on earth to those he favors.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
verses.decoded: After the angels left and went back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, 'Let's go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us about.'

verses.kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
verses.decoded: They hurried to Bethlehem and found Mary, Joseph, and the baby lying in a feeding trough.

verses.kjv: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
verses.decoded: After seeing the child, they told everyone what they had been told about him.

verses.kjv: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
verses.decoded: All who heard this were amazed at what the shepherds said.

verses.kjv: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
verses.decoded: But Mary kept all these things in her heart and thought about them often.

verses.kjv: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
verses.decoded: The shepherds returned, praising and thanking God for everything they had heard and seen, just as they had been told.

verses.kjv: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.decoded: After eight days, when the baby was circumcised, he was named Jesus, the name given by the angel before he was conceived.

verses.kjv: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
verses.decoded: When the time came for Mary's purification according to the law of Moses, they brought Jesus to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord.

verses.kjv: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
verses.decoded: (As the Lord's law says, 'Every firstborn male is to be dedicated to the Lord.')

verses.kjv: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
verses.decoded: They also offered a sacrifice as required by the law of the Lord: two young pigeons or two doves.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
verses.decoded: There was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon. He was a good and devout man, waiting for Israel's comfort, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

verses.kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
verses.decoded: The Holy Spirit had told him that he would not die before he saw the Lord's Messiah.

verses.kjv: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
verses.decoded: Led by the Spirit, he went to the temple. When Jesus' parents brought him in to follow the law's requirements,

verses.kjv: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.decoded: Simeon took the child in his arms, praised God, and said,

verses.kjv: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
verses.decoded: 'Lord, now you can let your servant die in peace, as you promised,

verses.kjv: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
verses.decoded: 'because my eyes have seen your salvation,

verses.kjv: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
verses.decoded: Which you have prepared in front of all people;

verses.kjv: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
verses.decoded: A light to bring understanding to the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel.

verses.kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
verses.decoded: And Joseph and his mother were amazed at what was said about him.

verses.kjv: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
verses.decoded: Then Simeon blessed them and said to Mary his mother, 'Look, this child is chosen to cause many in Israel to fall and rise again; he will be a sign that people will oppose.'

verses.kjv: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
verses.decoded: (Yes, a sword will pierce your own soul too,) so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed.

verses.kjv: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
verses.decoded: There was also a prophetess named Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, from the tribe of Asher. She was very old and had been married for seven years after she was a virgin;

verses.kjv: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
verses.decoded: and she was a widow for about eighty-four years. She never left the temple but worshiped God with fasting and prayer day and night.

verses.kjv: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: At that moment she came and thanked the Lord, and spoke about Jesus to all who were waiting for God's rescue in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
verses.decoded: After they had done everything required by the Lord's law, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.

verses.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.decoded: The child grew and became strong in spirit, filled with wisdom, and God's grace was on him.

verses.kjv: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
verses.decoded: Every year his parents went to Jerusalem for the Passover festival.

verses.kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
verses.decoded: When Jesus was twelve years old, they went to Jerusalem as usual for the festival.

verses.kjv: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
verses.decoded: After the festival was over and they were returning home, Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem without his parents knowing it.

verses.kjv: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
verses.decoded: They thought he was with their group, so they traveled for a day and then started looking for him among their relatives and friends.

verses.kjv: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
verses.decoded: When they did not find him, they went back to Jerusalem to look for him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
verses.decoded: After three days, they found him in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking questions.

verses.kjv: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
verses.decoded: Everyone who heard him was amazed at his understanding and his answers.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
verses.decoded: He said to them, 'Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know I had to be in my Father’s house?'

verses.kjv: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
verses.decoded: But they did not understand what he meant.

verses.kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
verses.decoded: Then he went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But his mother kept all these things in her heart.

verses.kjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
verses.decoded: And Jesus grew in wisdom and in physical growth, and gained favor with God and with people.

verses.kjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.decoded: In the fifteenth year of Tiberius Caesar's rule, when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod was ruler of Galilee, his brother Philip ruled Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias ruled Abilene,

verses.kjv: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: and Annas and Caiaphas were the high priests, God's message came to John, the son of Zechariah, while he was in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
verses.decoded: He went through the whole area around the Jordan River, preaching a baptism that called people to turn from their sins.

verses.kjv: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.decoded: As it is written in the book of the prophet Isaiah: 'A voice cries out in the wilderness, Prepare the way for the Lord; make his paths straight.'

verses.kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
verses.decoded: Every valley will be filled, every mountain and hill will be made low; crooked places will be made straight, and rough roads smooth;

verses.kjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
verses.decoded: and all people will see God's salvation.

verses.kjv: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.decoded: John said to the crowds who came to be baptized by him, 'You snakes! Who warned you to run away from the coming punishment?'

verses.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.decoded: Produce good deeds that show you have changed your hearts. Don’t just say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father.' I tell you, God can raise children for Abraham from these stones.

verses.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.decoded: Even now the axe is ready to cut down the trees at the root. Every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

verses.kjv: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
verses.decoded: The people asked him, 'Then what should we do?'

verses.kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
verses.decoded: He answered, 'If you have two shirts, share with someone who has none. If you have food, do the same.'

verses.kjv: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
verses.decoded: Even tax collectors came to be baptized and asked, 'Teacher, what should we do?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
verses.decoded: He told them, 'Don’t collect more than you are required to.'

verses.kjv: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
verses.decoded: Soldiers also asked, 'And what should we do?' He said, 'Don’t use violence against anyone. Don’t accuse anyone falsely. Be satisfied with your pay.'

verses.kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
verses.decoded: While the people were waiting and wondering in their hearts if John might be the Messiah,

verses.kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
verses.decoded: John said to them all, 'I baptize you with water, but someone much greater than I will come. I’m not even worthy to untie the straps of his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.'

verses.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
verses.decoded: He will hold a fan in his hand to clean his threshing floor. He will gather the wheat into his barn, but he will burn the chaff with fire that never goes out.

verses.kjv: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
verses.decoded: John said many other things to encourage the people.

verses.kjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
verses.decoded: But when Herod the ruler was criticized by John for marrying Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the wrong things he had done,

verses.kjv: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
verses.decoded: Herod added one more wrong by putting John in prison.

verses.kjv: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
verses.decoded: After all the people were baptized, Jesus was baptized too. While he was praying, heaven opened,

verses.kjv: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verses.decoded: and the Holy Spirit came down on him in a body like a dove. A voice came from heaven, saying, 'You are my beloved Son; I am very pleased with you.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
verses.decoded: Jesus was about thirty years old when he began his work. He was thought to be the son of Joseph, who was the son of Heli,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Matthat, who was the son of Levi, who was the son of Melchi, who was the son of Janna, who was the son of Joseph,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Mattathias, who was the son of Amos, who was the son of Nahum, who was the son of Esli, who was the son of Nagge,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Maath, who was the son of Mattathias, who was the son of Semei, who was the son of Joseph, who was the son of Judah,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Joanna, who was the son of Rhesa, who was the son of Zerubbabel, who was the son of Shealtiel, who was the son of Neri,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Melchi, who was the son of Addi, who was the son of Cosam, who was the son of Elmodam, who was the son of Er,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Jose, who was the son of Eliezer, who was the son of Jorim, who was the son of Matthat, who was the son of Levi,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Simeon, who was the son of Judah, who was the son of Joseph, who was the son of Jonan, who was the son of Eliakim,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Melea, who was the son of Menan, who was the son of Mattatha, who was the son of Nathan, who was the son of David.

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
verses.decoded: He was the son of Jesse, who was the son of Obed, who was the son of Boaz, who was the son of Salmon, who was the son of Nahshon,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Aminadab, who was the son of Aram, who was the son of Hezron, who was the son of Perez, who was the son of Judah,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Jacob, who was the son of Isaac, who was the son of Abraham, who was the son of Terah, who was the son of Nahor,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Serug, who was the son of Reu, who was the son of Peleg, who was the son of Eber, who was the son of Shelah,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
verses.decoded: who was the son of Methuselah, who was the son of Enoch, who was the son of Jared, who was the son of Mahalalel, who was the son of Cainan,

verses.kjv: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
verses.decoded: who was the son of Enosh, who was the son of Seth, who was the son of Adam, who was the son of God.

verses.kjv: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
verses.decoded: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, came back from the Jordan River and was guided by the Spirit into the wilderness.

verses.kjv: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
verses.decoded: He was tempted by the devil for forty days. During that time, he did not eat anything, and when it was over, he was hungry.

verses.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
verses.decoded: The devil said to him, 'If you are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'It is written, People do not live by bread alone, but by every word from God.'

verses.kjv: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.decoded: Then the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in an instant.

verses.kjv: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
verses.decoded: The devil said, 'I will give you all this power and their glory, because they have been given to me, and I can give them to anyone I want.'

verses.kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
verses.decoded: 'So if you worship me, all of this will be yours.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Go away, Satan! It is written, You must worship the Lord your God and serve only him.'

verses.kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
verses.decoded: The devil took him to Jerusalem and set him on the highest point of the temple. He said, 'If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down from here.'

verses.kjv: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
verses.decoded: For it is written, 'God will command his angels to protect you.'

verses.kjv: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.decoded: They will catch you with their hands so you will not hurt your foot on a stone.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'It also says, You must not test the Lord your God.'

verses.kjv: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
verses.decoded: After the devil finished all the temptations, he left him for a while.

verses.kjv: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
verses.decoded: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about him spread through the whole area.

verses.kjv: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
verses.decoded: He taught in their synagogues, and everyone praised him.

verses.kjv: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
verses.decoded: He went to Nazareth, where he had grown up. On the Sabbath, as usual, he went to the synagogue and stood up to read.

verses.kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
verses.decoded: The scroll of the prophet Isaiah was given to him. When he opened it, he found the place where it was written,

verses.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
verses.decoded: 'The Spirit of the Lord is on me because he has chosen me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal those with broken hearts, to announce freedom for prisoners, and to give sight to the blind. He has sent me to free those who are oppressed,'

verses.kjv: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
verses.decoded: 'to announce the year when the Lord will save his people.'

verses.kjv: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.decoded: He closed the scroll, gave it back to the helper, and sat down. Everyone in the synagogue was watching him closely.

verses.kjv: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
verses.decoded: He began to say, 'Today this scripture is fulfilled as you listen.'

verses.kjv: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?
verses.decoded: Everyone spoke well of him and was amazed at the kind words he spoke. They said, 'Isn't this Joseph's son?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
verses.decoded: He said to them, 'You will surely say to me, "Doctor, heal yourself! Do here in your hometown what we heard you did in Capernaum."'

verses.kjv: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
verses.decoded: He said, 'I tell you the truth, no prophet is accepted in his own hometown.'

verses.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
verses.decoded: He said, 'There were many widows in Israel during the time of Elijah when the sky was closed for three and a half years and there was a great famine throughout the land.

verses.kjv: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
verses.decoded: But Elijah was not sent to any of them except to a widow in Zarephath, a town in Sidon.'

verses.kjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
verses.decoded: There were many lepers in Israel during the time of Elisha the prophet, but none of them were healed except Naaman the Syrian.'

verses.kjv: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
verses.decoded: When everyone in the synagogue heard this, they were very angry.

verses.kjv: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
verses.decoded: They got up, forced him out of the town, and took him to the edge of the hill where their town was built, intending to throw him off the cliff.

verses.kjv: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
verses.decoded: But he walked right through the crowd and went away.

verses.kjv: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
verses.decoded: He went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and taught there on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
verses.decoded: Everyone was amazed at his teaching because his words had power.

verses.kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
verses.decoded: In the synagogue there was a man who had an evil spirit, and he shouted loudly,

verses.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
verses.decoded: saying, 'Leave us alone! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are— the Holy One of God!'

verses.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
verses.decoded: But Jesus told him, 'Be quiet, and come out of him!' The evil spirit threw the man down in front of everyone and left him without harming him.

verses.kjv: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
verses.decoded: Everyone was amazed and talked among themselves, saying, 'What kind of teaching is this? He gives orders to evil spirits, and they obey him!'

verses.kjv: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
verses.decoded: News about Jesus spread quickly throughout the whole region.

verses.kjv: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
verses.decoded: Jesus left the synagogue and went to Simon's house. Simon's mother-in-law was very sick with a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her.

verses.kjv: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
verses.decoded: Jesus stood over her, told the fever to leave, and it left her. She got up at once and began to serve them.

verses.kjv: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.decoded: As the sun was setting, people brought all who were sick with various diseases to Jesus. He laid his hands on each one and healed them.

verses.kjv: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
verses.decoded: Evil spirits also came out of many people, shouting, 'You are the Messiah, the Son of God!' But Jesus stopped them from speaking because they knew he was the Messiah.

verses.kjv: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
verses.decoded: Early the next morning, Jesus went to a quiet place. The people searched for him, found him, and tried to keep him from leaving.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'I must preach about God's kingdom in other towns too, because that is why I was sent.'

verses.kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.decoded: So Jesus preached in the synagogues throughout Galilee.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
verses.decoded: One day, as the crowd pressed around him to hear God's message, Jesus stood by the lake of Gennesaret.

verses.kjv: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
verses.decoded: He saw two boats at the shore, but the fishermen had left them and were washing their nets.

verses.kjv: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
verses.decoded: Jesus got into one of the boats, which belonged to Simon, and asked him to push out a little from the shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.

verses.kjv: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
verses.decoded: When he finished speaking, he said to Simon, 'Go out into deep water and lower your nets to catch fish.'

verses.kjv: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
verses.decoded: Simon answered, 'Master, we worked hard all night and caught nothing. But because you say so, I will lower the nets.'

verses.kjv: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
verses.decoded: When they did this, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.

verses.kjv: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
verses.decoded: They signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help. They came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.

verses.kjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
verses.decoded: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell to his knees before Jesus and said, 'Go away from me, Lord, because I am a sinful man.'

verses.kjv: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
verses.decoded: He and all his companions were amazed at the huge catch of fish they had taken.

verses.kjv: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
verses.decoded: This was also true for James and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, 'Don’t be afraid. From now on, you will catch people.'

verses.kjv: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
verses.decoded: When they brought their boats to shore, they left everything and followed Jesus.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.decoded: One day, while Jesus was in a certain town, a man full of leprosy saw him, fell face down, and begged, 'Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.'

verses.kjv: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
verses.decoded: Jesus reached out his hand, touched him, and said, 'I want to. Be clean.' Immediately the leprosy left the man.

verses.kjv: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.decoded: Jesus told him not to tell anyone, but to go show himself to the priest and offer the required sacrifice for his cleansing, as Moses commanded, to prove it to them.

verses.kjv: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
verses.decoded: But news about Jesus spread even more, and large crowds came to hear him and be healed of their sicknesses.

verses.kjv: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
verses.decoded: Jesus often withdrew to lonely places to pray.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
verses.decoded: One day, while he was teaching, Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting nearby. They had come from every town in Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was present to heal them.

verses.kjv: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
verses.decoded: Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat. They tried to bring him in and lay him before Jesus.

verses.kjv: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
verses.decoded: Because of the crowd, they could not get in, so they went up on the roof, removed some tiles, and lowered the man on his mat right in front of Jesus.

verses.kjv: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the man, 'Friend, your sins are forgiven.'

verses.kjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
verses.decoded: The teachers of the law and Pharisees began to question, 'Who is this man who speaks against God? Only God can forgive sins!'

verses.kjv: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
verses.decoded: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked them, 'Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?'

verses.kjv: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
verses.decoded: 'Which is easier: to say, Your sins are forgiven, or to say, Get up and walk?'

verses.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
verses.decoded: 'But so you will know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,' Jesus said to the paralyzed man, 'I tell you, get up, take your mat, and go home.'

verses.kjv: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
verses.decoded: Immediately the man stood up in front of them, picked up his mat, and went home, praising God.

verses.kjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
verses.decoded: Everyone was amazed and praised God, filled with awe, saying, 'We have seen amazing things today.'

verses.kjv: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
verses.decoded: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at his tax booth. Jesus said to him, 'Follow me.'

verses.kjv: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
verses.decoded: Levi left everything, stood up, and followed him.

verses.kjv: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
verses.decoded: Levi held a big feast at his house for Jesus, and many tax collectors and others were eating with them.

verses.kjv: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
verses.decoded: But the teachers of the law and Pharisees complained to Jesus’ followers, 'Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Healthy people don’t need a doctor, but sick people do.'

verses.kjv: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.decoded: I did not come to call those who think they are right, but sinners to change their hearts.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'Why do John's followers fast often and pray, and the Pharisees' followers do the same, but your followers eat and drink?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.decoded: He answered, 'Can you make the people celebrating a wedding fast while the groom is still with them?'

verses.kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.decoded: But the time will come when the groom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

verses.kjv: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
verses.decoded: He also told them a story: No one patches an old piece of clothing with a new piece, because the new patch will tear away from the old cloth, making the tear worse.

verses.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
verses.decoded: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, because the new wine will burst the old skins, spilling the wine and ruining the skins.

verses.kjv: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
verses.decoded: New wine must be put into new wineskins, and both will be kept safe.

verses.kjv: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
verses.decoded: No one who has tasted old wine wants new wine right away, because they say, 'The old wine is better.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.decoded: One sabbath, after the first one, Jesus went through some grain fields. His followers picked some heads of grain and ate them by rubbing them in their hands.

verses.kjv: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
verses.decoded: Some Pharisees asked, 'Why are you doing what is not allowed on the sabbath?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Have you never read what David did when he was hungry, and those with him?'

verses.kjv: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
verses.decoded: He went into God's house, took the bread that only priests are allowed to eat, and ate it, giving some to his companions.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.decoded: Then Jesus said, 'The Son of Man is also the Lord of the sabbath.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
verses.decoded: On another sabbath, Jesus went into a synagogue and taught. There was a man there whose right hand was shriveled.

verses.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.decoded: The teachers of the law and Pharisees watched closely to see if Jesus would heal on the sabbath, so they could accuse him.

verses.kjv: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
verses.decoded: Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, 'Stand up here.' He stood up.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
verses.decoded: Jesus asked them, 'Is it right to do good or evil on the sabbath? To save life or to destroy it?'

verses.kjv: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.decoded: Then Jesus looked at them all and told the man, 'Stretch out your hand.' He did, and it was completely healed like the other.

verses.kjv: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.decoded: The Pharisees were filled with anger and talked about what they could do to Jesus.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.decoded: During those days, Jesus went up on a mountain to pray and spent the whole night praying to God.

verses.kjv: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
verses.decoded: When morning came, he called his followers and chose twelve of them, whom he named apostles.

verses.kjv: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.decoded: They were Simon (whom he named Peter), Andrew his brother, James, John, Philip, and Bartholomew.

verses.kjv: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
verses.decoded: Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, and Simon called the Zealot.

verses.kjv: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
verses.decoded: Judas, brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, who later became a traitor.

verses.kjv: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.decoded: Jesus came down with them and stood on a plain. A large crowd of his followers and many people from all over Judea, Jerusalem, and the coastal areas of Tyre and Sidon had come to hear him and be healed of their diseases.

verses.kjv: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
verses.decoded: Those troubled by evil spirits were also healed.

verses.kjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
verses.decoded: The whole crowd wanted to touch him because power was coming from him and healing them all.

verses.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for your's is the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: Jesus looked at his followers and said, 'Happy are you who are poor, because the kingdom of God belongs to you.'

verses.kjv: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
verses.decoded: Happy are you who are hungry now, because you will be satisfied. Happy are you who are crying now, because you will laugh.

verses.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
verses.decoded: Happy are you when people hate you, exclude you, insult you, and reject your name as evil because of the Son of Man.

verses.kjv: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
verses.decoded: Be glad on that day and jump for joy, because your reward in heaven will be great. Their ancestors treated the prophets the same way.

verses.kjv: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
verses.decoded: But how terrible for you who are rich, because you have already received your comfort.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
verses.decoded: How terrible for you who are full now, because you will be hungry. How terrible for you who laugh now, because you will grieve and cry.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.decoded: How terrible for you when everyone speaks well of you, because their ancestors treated the false prophets the same way.

verses.kjv: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
verses.decoded: But I tell you who are listening: Love your enemies. Do good to those who hate you.

verses.kjv: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
verses.decoded: Bless those who curse you. Pray for those who treat you badly.

verses.kjv: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
verses.decoded: If someone hits you on one cheek, offer the other cheek too. If someone takes your coat, don’t stop them from taking your shirt as well.

verses.kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
verses.decoded: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask for your things back from anyone who takes them.

verses.kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.decoded: Treat others the way you want them to treat you.

verses.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
verses.decoded: If you only love those who love you, what reward do you have? Even sinners love those who love them.

verses.kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
verses.decoded: If you do good only to those who do good to you, what reward do you have? Even sinners do the same.

verses.kjv: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
verses.decoded: If you lend only to those you expect to pay you back, what reward do you have? Even sinners lend to sinners to get the same back.

verses.kjv: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
verses.decoded: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend without expecting anything back. Your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and the wicked.

verses.kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
verses.decoded: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.

verses.kjv: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
verses.decoded: Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.decoded: Give, and it will be given to you. A good amount, pressed down, shaken together, and overflowing will be poured into your lap. The amount you give will be the amount you get back.

verses.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
verses.decoded: He told them a story: Can the blind lead the blind? Won't they both fall into a ditch?

verses.kjv: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
verses.decoded: A student is not above the teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like their teacher.

verses.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.decoded: Why do you look at the speck in your brother's eye but do not notice the beam in your own eye?

verses.kjv: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
verses.decoded: How can you say to your brother, 'Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,' when you do not see the beam in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the beam out of your own eye, then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother's eye.

verses.kjv: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.decoded: A good tree does not produce bad fruit, and a bad tree does not produce good fruit.

verses.kjv: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
verses.decoded: Every tree is known by its own fruit. People do not pick figs from thornbushes or grapes from bramble bushes.

verses.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
verses.decoded: A good person produces good things from the good stored in their heart, and an evil person produces evil things from the evil stored in their heart. What comes out of the mouth shows what is in the heart.

verses.kjv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
verses.decoded: Why do you call me 'Lord, Lord,' but do not do what I say?

verses.kjv: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
verses.decoded: Anyone who comes to me, listens to my words, and puts them into practice, I will show you who they are like:

verses.kjv: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.decoded: They are like a man who built a house, dug deep, and laid the foundation on rock. When the flood came, the river beat hard against that house but could not shake it because it was well built.

verses.kjv: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
verses.decoded: But the one who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. The river beat against that house, and it immediately fell, and the destruction was great.

verses.kjv: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.decoded: Later, Jesus traveled through every town and village, preaching and sharing the good news about God's kingdom. The twelve disciples were with him.

verses.kjv: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
verses.decoded: A Roman officer had a servant he cared about who was very sick and close to death.

verses.kjv: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
verses.decoded: When the officer heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish elders to ask Jesus to come and heal his servant.

verses.kjv: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
verses.decoded: When the elders reached Jesus, they begged him quickly, saying, 'This man deserves your help.'

verses.kjv: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
verses.decoded: He loves our people, and he built our synagogue.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
verses.decoded: So Jesus went with them. But when he was almost at the house, the officer sent friends to say, 'Lord, don’t trouble yourself. I am not worthy to have you come under my roof.'

verses.kjv: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.decoded: That’s why I didn’t even think I was worthy to come to you. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

verses.kjv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.decoded: I am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. When I tell one to go, he goes; when I tell another to come, he comes; and when I tell my servant to do something, he does it.

verses.kjv: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.decoded: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed and turned to the crowd following him. He said, 'I tell you, I haven’t found faith like this anywhere in Israel.'

verses.kjv: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
verses.decoded: The men who had been sent returned to the house and found the servant completely healed.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
verses.decoded: The next day Jesus went to a town called Nain, and many of his followers and a large crowd went with him.

verses.kjv: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.decoded: As he approached the city gate, a dead man was being carried out. He was the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people from the town were with her.

verses.kjv: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.decoded: When the Lord saw her, he felt sorry for her and said, 'Don’t cry.'

verses.kjv: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
verses.decoded: He went up and touched the coffin, and those carrying it stopped. Then he said, 'Young man, I say to you, get up!'

verses.kjv: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
verses.decoded: The dead man sat up and began to talk. Jesus gave him back to his mother.

verses.kjv: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
verses.decoded: Everyone was filled with awe and praised God, saying, 'A great prophet has come among us,' and 'God has come to help his people.'

verses.kjv: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
verses.decoded: News about Jesus spread throughout all Judea and the surrounding area.

verses.kjv: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
