verses.kjv: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
verses.decoded: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and sky, but why don't you know how to interpret this time?

verses.kjv: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
verses.decoded: Why don't you even judge for yourselves what is right?

verses.kjv: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
verses.decoded: When you go with your opponent before a judge, try to settle the matter on the way, or you may be thrown into prison.

verses.kjv: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
verses.decoded: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.

verses.kjv: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
verses.decoded: At that time, some people told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?
verses.decoded: Jesus answered them, 'Do you think these Galileans were worse sinners than all other Galileans because they suffered like that?'

verses.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
verses.decoded: I tell you, no. But unless you change your hearts, you will all die the same way.

verses.kjv: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
verses.decoded: Or what about the eighteen people who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them? Do you think they were worse sinners than everyone else living in Jerusalem?

verses.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
verses.decoded: I tell you, no. But unless you change your hearts, you will all die the same way.

verses.kjv: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
verses.decoded: Jesus told this story: A man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard. He came to look for fruit on it but found none.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
verses.decoded: He said to the man who took care of the vineyard, 'For three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree and found none. Cut it down. Why is it wasting the soil?'

verses.kjv: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
verses.decoded: But the man answered, 'Sir, leave it alone this year too. I will dig around it and put fertilizer on it.

verses.kjv: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.
verses.decoded: If it bears fruit, fine. But if not, then you can cut it down.'

verses.kjv: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
verses.decoded: Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
verses.decoded: There was a woman there who had been crippled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and could not straighten up at all.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw her, he called her over and said, 'Woman, you are free from your sickness.'

verses.kjv: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
verses.decoded: Then he placed his hands on her, and she immediately stood up straight and praised God.

verses.kjv: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
verses.decoded: The leader of the synagogue was angry because Jesus healed on the Sabbath. He told the people, 'There are six days for work. Come and be healed on those days, not on the Sabbath.'

verses.kjv: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
verses.decoded: The Lord answered him, 'You hypocrite! Doesn’t each of you untie your ox or donkey on the Sabbath and lead it to water?

verses.kjv: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
verses.decoded: Shouldn’t this woman, a daughter of Abraham whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen years, be set free on the Sabbath?'

verses.kjv: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.decoded: After Jesus said this, all his enemies were ashamed, and the people were happy about all the wonderful things he did.

verses.kjv: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
verses.decoded: Then Jesus asked, 'What is the kingdom of God like? What can I compare it to?'

verses.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
verses.decoded: It is like a mustard seed that a man planted in his garden. It grew and became a large tree, and birds made their nests in its branches.

verses.kjv: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
verses.decoded: Again he asked, 'What can I compare the kingdom of God to?'

verses.kjv: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.decoded: It is like yeast that a woman mixed into three measures of flour until the whole batch was leavened.

verses.kjv: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Jesus went through towns and villages, teaching and traveling toward Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
verses.decoded: Someone asked him, 'Lord, will only a few people be saved?' Jesus answered,

verses.kjv: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
verses.decoded: 'Work hard to enter through the narrow door, because many will try to enter but won’t be able to.'

verses.kjv: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
verses.decoded: After the owner of the house has gotten up and closed the door, you will stand outside knocking and asking, 'Lord, open the door for us.' But he will answer, 'I don’t know you or where you come from.'

verses.kjv: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
verses.decoded: Then you will say, 'We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.'

verses.kjv: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
verses.decoded: But he will say, 'I tell you, I don’t know you or where you come from. Get away from me, all you who do wrong.'

verses.kjv: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
verses.decoded: There will be weeping and grinding of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s kingdom, but you are thrown out.

verses.kjv: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: People will come from east, west, north, and south and will sit down in God’s kingdom.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
verses.decoded: Look! Some who are last now will be first, and some who are first will be last.

verses.kjv: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
verses.decoded: That same day some Pharisees came to him and said, 'Leave here and go away, because Herod wants to kill you.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
verses.decoded: He answered them, 'Go and tell that fox, I am casting out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will be complete.'

verses.kjv: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: But I must continue my work today, tomorrow, and the next day, because it is impossible for a prophet to die outside Jerusalem.'

verses.kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.decoded: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I wanted to gather your children together like a mother hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you refused!

verses.kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Look, your house is left empty. I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, 'Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
verses.decoded: One Sabbath, Jesus went to eat at the home of a leading Pharisee, and they were watching him closely.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
verses.decoded: There was a man there who had swelling caused by fluid retention.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
verses.decoded: Jesus spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, asking, 'Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?'

verses.kjv: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
verses.decoded: They remained silent. Jesus healed the man and sent him away.

verses.kjv: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
verses.decoded: Then Jesus asked, 'If one of you has a donkey or an ox that falls into a pit on the Sabbath, wouldn't you immediately pull it out?'

verses.kjv: And they could not answer him again to these things.
verses.decoded: They could not answer him.

verses.kjv: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
verses.decoded: Jesus noticed how the guests chose the places of honor and told them a story.

verses.kjv: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
verses.decoded: 'When you are invited to a wedding, don’t sit in the place of honor in case someone more important is invited by the host.'

verses.kjv: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
verses.decoded: 'Then the host might come and say to you, "Give this person your seat." You would be embarrassed to take the lowest place.'

verses.kjv: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
verses.decoded: 'Instead, when you are invited, take the lowest place. Then when the host comes, he may say, "Friend, come up higher." Then you will be honored in front of all the guests.'

verses.kjv: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.decoded: 'Those who lift themselves up will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be lifted up.'

verses.kjv: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
verses.decoded: Then Jesus said to the host, 'When you give a lunch or dinner, don’t invite your friends, brothers, relatives, or rich neighbors, or they may invite you back and you will be repaid.'

verses.kjv: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
verses.decoded: 'Instead, invite the poor, the disabled, the lame, and the blind.'

verses.kjv: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
verses.decoded: 'Then you will be blessed because they cannot repay you. You will be repaid when the righteous are raised to life.'

verses.kjv: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: One of the guests said, 'Happy is the one who will eat at the kingdom of God.'

verses.kjv: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'A man gave a big dinner and invited many guests.'

verses.kjv: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
verses.decoded: At dinner time, he sent his servant to tell the guests, 'Come, the meal is ready.'

verses.kjv: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
verses.decoded: But they all began to make excuses. The first said, 'I have bought some land and must go see it. Please excuse me.'

verses.kjv: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
verses.decoded: Another said, 'I have bought five pairs of oxen and need to test them. Please excuse me.'

verses.kjv: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
verses.decoded: Another said, 'I just got married, so I can’t come.'

verses.kjv: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
verses.decoded: The servant told his master what they said. The master was angry and told the servant, 'Go quickly into the streets and alleys of the town and bring in the poor, disabled, lame, and blind.'

verses.kjv: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
verses.decoded: The servant said, 'Lord, I have done as you said, but there is still room.'

verses.kjv: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.decoded: The master told him, 'Go out to the roads and country lanes and make them come in so my house will be full.'

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
verses.decoded: 'I tell you, none of those who were invited will taste my dinner.'

verses.kjv: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
verses.decoded: Large crowds were following Jesus, and he turned and said to them,

verses.kjv: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.decoded: 'If anyone comes to me and does not hate his father, mother, wife, children, brothers, sisters, and even his own life, he cannot be my disciple.'

verses.kjv: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
verses.decoded: 'Whoever does not carry his cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.'

verses.kjv: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
verses.decoded: 'Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. Won’t you first sit down and estimate the cost to see if you have enough money to finish it?'

verses.kjv: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,
verses.decoded: 'Otherwise, after laying the foundation, if you cannot finish it, everyone who sees it will ridicule you,'

verses.kjv: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
verses.decoded: saying, 'This person started to build but couldn’t finish.'

verses.kjv: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
verses.decoded: 'Or suppose a king is going to war against another king. Won’t he first sit down and consider whether he is able with ten thousand men to oppose the one coming against him with twenty thousand?'

verses.kjv: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.
verses.decoded: Or else, while the other army is still far away, he sends messengers to ask for peace terms.

verses.kjv: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.decoded: In the same way, anyone of you who does not give up everything he owns cannot be my follower.

verses.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
verses.decoded: Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?

verses.kjv: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.decoded: It is no longer good for the soil or the manure pile; people throw it away. Anyone who has ears to hear should listen.

verses.kjv: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
verses.decoded: All the tax collectors and sinners came near to listen to him.

verses.kjv: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
verses.decoded: But the Pharisees and teachers of the law complained, saying, 'This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.'

verses.kjv: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
verses.decoded: Then he told them this story:

verses.kjv: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
verses.decoded: Which of you, having a hundred sheep, if he loses one, does not leave the ninety-nine in the open country and go after the lost one until he finds it?

verses.kjv: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.decoded: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders.

verses.kjv: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
verses.decoded: When he comes home, he calls his friends and neighbors together and says, 'Rejoice with me because I have found my lost sheep.'

verses.kjv: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
verses.decoded: I tell you, there is more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous people who do not need to repent.

verses.kjv: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?
verses.decoded: Or what woman having ten silver coins, if she loses one coin, does not light a lamp, sweep the house, and search carefully until she finds it?

verses.kjv: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
verses.decoded: When she finds it, she calls her friends and neighbors and says, 'Rejoice with me because I have found the coin I lost.'

verses.kjv: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
verses.decoded: In the same way, I tell you, there is joy among the angels of God over one sinner who repents.

verses.kjv: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
verses.decoded: Then he said, 'There was a man who had two sons.'

verses.kjv: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
verses.decoded: The younger son said to his father, 'Father, give me my share of the estate.' So the father divided his property between them.

verses.kjv: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
verses.decoded: Not long after, the younger son gathered all he had and traveled to a distant country, where he wasted his wealth living recklessly.

verses.kjv: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
verses.decoded: After he had spent everything, a severe famine struck that country, and he began to be in need.

verses.kjv: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
verses.decoded: So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him to feed pigs.

verses.kjv: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
verses.decoded: He longed to fill his stomach with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.

verses.kjv: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
verses.decoded: When he came to his senses, he said, 'How many of my father's hired workers have more than enough food, and here I am starving to death!'

verses.kjv: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
verses.decoded: I will get up and go to my father and say to him, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.'

verses.kjv: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
verses.decoded: I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired workers.'

verses.kjv: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
verses.decoded: So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him, felt compassion, ran to him, embraced him, and kissed him.

verses.kjv: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
verses.decoded: The son said to him, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.'

verses.kjv: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
verses.decoded: But the father said to his servants, 'Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.'

verses.kjv: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
verses.decoded: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let's eat and celebrate.

verses.kjv: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
verses.decoded: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.' So they began to celebrate.

verses.kjv: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
verses.decoded: Meanwhile, the older son was working in the field. When he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.

verses.kjv: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
verses.decoded: He called one of the servants and asked what was going on.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
verses.decoded: The servant said, 'Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has him back safe and sound.'

verses.kjv: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
verses.decoded: The older son became angry and refused to go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.

verses.kjv: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
verses.decoded: But he answered his father, 'Look, all these years I have served you and never disobeyed your orders. Yet you never gave me even a young goat to celebrate with my friends.'

verses.kjv: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
verses.decoded: But when this son of yours who has wasted your property with prostitutes comes home, you kill the fattened calf for him!'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
verses.decoded: The father said to him, 'Son, you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

verses.kjv: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
verses.decoded: It was right for us to celebrate and be happy, because your brother was dead but is now alive; he was lost but is now found.

verses.kjv: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
verses.decoded: Jesus also told his disciples, There was a rich man who had a manager, and this manager was accused of wasting his master's property.

verses.kjv: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
verses.decoded: The rich man called him and said, How is it that I hear these charges against you? Give me an account of your management, because you can no longer be my manager.

verses.kjv: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
verses.decoded: The manager thought to himself, What will I do now that my master is taking away my job? I am not strong enough to work in the fields, and I am ashamed to beg.

verses.kjv: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
verses.decoded: I know what to do so that when I lose my job, people will welcome me into their homes.

verses.kjv: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
verses.decoded: He called in each of his master's debtors. He asked the first, How much do you owe my master?

verses.kjv: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
verses.decoded: He answered, One hundred measures of olive oil. The manager said, Take your bill and sit down quickly and write fifty.

verses.kjv: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
verses.decoded: Then he asked another, And how much do you owe? He replied, One hundred measures of wheat. The manager said, Take your bill and write eighty.

verses.kjv: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
verses.decoded: The master praised the dishonest manager because he had acted wisely. For people of this world are more clever in dealing with their own kind than people of the light are.

verses.kjv: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
verses.decoded: I tell you, use worldly wealth to make friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, they will welcome you into eternal homes.

verses.kjv: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
verses.decoded: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much. Whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.

verses.kjv: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
verses.decoded: If you are not faithful with worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?

verses.kjv: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?
verses.decoded: And if you are not faithful with what belongs to someone else, who will give you what is truly yours?

verses.kjv: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.decoded: No servant can serve two masters. He will either hate one and love the other, or be loyal to one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.

verses.kjv: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
verses.decoded: The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and laughed at Jesus.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, You are the ones who justify yourselves in front of people, but God knows your hearts. What people value highly is detestable in God's sight.

verses.kjv: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
verses.decoded: The Law and the Prophets were in effect until John. Since then, the kingdom of God has been preached, and everyone is forcing their way into it.

verses.kjv: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
verses.decoded: It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the smallest letter of the Law to become invalid.

verses.kjv: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
verses.decoded: Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery. Anyone who marries a divorced woman also commits adultery.

verses.kjv: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
verses.decoded: There was a rich man who dressed in purple and fine linen and lived in luxury every day.

verses.kjv: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
verses.decoded: At his gate lay a beggar named Lazarus, covered with sores.

verses.kjv: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.decoded: He longed to eat what fell from the rich man's table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
verses.decoded: The beggar died and was carried by angels to Abraham's side. The rich man also died and was buried.

verses.kjv: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
verses.decoded: In hell, he looked up and saw Abraham far away, with Lazarus by his side.

verses.kjv: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
verses.decoded: He called out, Father Abraham, have mercy on me! Send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in agony in this fire.

verses.kjv: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
verses.decoded: But Abraham said, Son, remember that during your life you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things. Now he is comforted here, and you are in agony.

verses.kjv: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
verses.decoded: Besides all this, there is a great chasm between us, so that no one can cross from here to you, or from there to us.

verses.kjv: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:
verses.decoded: The rich man said, Then I beg you, father, send Lazarus to my family.

verses.kjv: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
verses.decoded: I have five brothers. Let him warn them so they will not also come to this place of torment.

verses.kjv: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
verses.decoded: Abraham replied, They have Moses and the prophets; let them listen to them.

verses.kjv: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
verses.decoded: He said, No, father Abraham, but if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
verses.decoded: Abraham said, If they do not listen to Moses and the prophets, they will not be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
verses.decoded: Jesus told them a story to show that people should always pray and never give up.

verses.kjv: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
verses.decoded: It would be better for that person to have a heavy millstone tied around their neck and be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to sin.

verses.kjv: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
verses.decoded: Be careful about yourselves. If your brother sins against you, correct him; and if he changes his mind, forgive him.

verses.kjv: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
verses.decoded: Even if he sins against you seven times in one day and comes back seven times saying, 'I am sorry,' you must forgive him.

verses.kjv: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
verses.decoded: The apostles said to the Lord, 'Increase our faith.'

verses.kjv: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
verses.decoded: The Lord said, 'If you had faith as small as a mustard seed, you could say to this sycamore tree, "Be uprooted and planted in the sea," and it would obey you.'

verses.kjv: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
verses.decoded: Which of you, having a servant working in the field or taking care of cattle, will say to him as soon as he comes in from the field, 'Come and sit down to eat'?

verses.kjv: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
verses.decoded: Won't he rather say, 'Get my meal ready, put on your apron, and serve me until I have eaten and drunk; then you may eat and drink'?

verses.kjv: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
verses.decoded: Does he thank the servant because he did what was commanded? I don't think so.

verses.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
verses.decoded: In the same way, when you have done everything you were told to do, say, 'We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
verses.decoded: As Jesus was going to Jerusalem, he passed through the middle of Samaria and Galilee.

verses.kjv: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
verses.decoded: As he entered a certain village, ten men who had leprosy met him. They stood far away.

verses.kjv: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
verses.decoded: They shouted, 'Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!'

verses.kjv: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
verses.decoded: When he saw them, he said, 'Go show yourselves to the priests.' As they went, they were healed.

verses.kjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
verses.decoded: One of them, when he saw he was healed, turned back and loudly praised God.

verses.kjv: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
verses.decoded: He fell face down at Jesus' feet and thanked him. This man was a Samaritan.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
verses.decoded: Jesus asked, 'Were not ten healed? Where are the other nine?'

verses.kjv: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
verses.decoded: No one returned to praise God except this foreigner.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, 'Get up and go. Your faith has healed you.'

verses.kjv: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
verses.decoded: When the Pharisees asked when God's kingdom would come, Jesus answered, 'God's kingdom does not come with visible signs.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
verses.decoded: He said to the disciples, 'The time will come when you will want to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.'

verses.kjv: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
verses.decoded: People will tell you, 'Look here!' or 'Look there!' but don't follow them.

verses.kjv: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
verses.decoded: Just as lightning shines from one side of the sky to the other, so will the Son of Man be on his day.

verses.kjv: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
verses.decoded: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

verses.kjv: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
verses.decoded: Just as it was in Noah's days, so it will be in the days of the Son of Man.

verses.kjv: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
verses.decoded: People ate and drank, married and were given in marriage until the day Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

verses.kjv: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
verses.decoded: It was the same in Lot's days: people ate, drank, bought, sold, planted, and built.

verses.kjv: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
verses.decoded: But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.

verses.kjv: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
verses.decoded: It will be the same on the day the Son of Man is revealed.

verses.kjv: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
verses.decoded: On that day, if someone is on the roof with belongings inside the house, don't come down to get them; if someone is in the field, don't go back for anything.

verses.kjv: Remember Lot's wife.
verses.decoded: Remember the wife of Lot.

verses.kjv: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
verses.decoded: Anyone who tries to save their life will lose it, but anyone who loses their life will keep it safe.

verses.kjv: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
verses.decoded: I tell you, that night there will be two men in one bed; one will be taken, and the other left.

verses.kjv: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.decoded: Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken, and the other left.

verses.kjv: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.decoded: Two men will be working in the field; one will be taken, and the other left.

verses.kjv: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'Where, Lord?' He answered, 'Wherever the body is, there the eagles will gather.'

verses.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
verses.decoded: Jesus told them a story to show that people should always pray and never give up.

verses.kjv: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
verses.decoded: There was a judge in a city who did not fear God or care about people.

verses.kjv: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
verses.decoded: A widow in that city came to him and said, 'Give me justice against my opponent.'

verses.kjv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
verses.decoded: At first he refused, but later he said to himself, 'Even though I don't fear God or care about people,

verses.kjv: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
verses.decoded: because this widow keeps bothering me, I will give her justice so she won't wear me out by coming again and again.'

verses.kjv: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
verses.decoded: The Lord said, 'Listen to what the dishonest judge says.'

verses.kjv: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
verses.decoded: Won't God give justice to his chosen ones who cry out to him day and night, even if he takes a long time?

verses.kjv: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
verses.decoded: I tell you, he will give them justice quickly. But when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?'

verses.kjv: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
verses.decoded: Jesus told this story to some people who thought they were good and looked down on others:

verses.kjv: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
verses.decoded: Two men went to the temple to pray. One was a Pharisee, the other a tax collector.

verses.kjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
verses.decoded: The Pharisee stood and prayed quietly to himself, 'God, I thank you that I am not like other people—cheaters, wrongdoers, or even like this tax collector.'

verses.kjv: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
verses.decoded: I fast twice a week and give a tenth of everything I earn.

verses.kjv: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
verses.decoded: But the tax collector stood far away and would not even look up to heaven. Instead, he beat his chest and said, 'God, be merciful to me, a sinner.'

verses.kjv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.decoded: I tell you, this man went home made right with God rather than the other. Those who make themselves important will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be made important.

verses.kjv: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
verses.decoded: People also brought babies to Jesus so he could touch them, but the disciples told them to stop.

verses.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: Jesus called the children to him and said, 'Let the little children come to me. Don’t stop them, because the kingdom of God belongs to those who are like these children.'

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, anyone who does not accept the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.

verses.kjv: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.decoded: A certain ruler asked Jesus, 'Good Teacher, what must I do to have eternal life?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, 'Why do you call me good? No one is good except God alone.'

verses.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
verses.decoded: You know the commandments: Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not lie, honor your father and mother.'

verses.kjv: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
verses.decoded: The man said, 'I have obeyed all these commandments since I was young.'

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
verses.decoded: When Jesus heard this, he said, 'You still lack one thing. Sell everything you have and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.'

verses.kjv: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
verses.decoded: When the man heard this, he became very sad because he was very rich.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
verses.decoded: Jesus saw that he was sad and said, 'It is very hard for rich people to enter the kingdom of God!'

verses.kjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter God’s kingdom.

verses.kjv: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
verses.decoded: Those who heard this said, 'Then who can be saved?'

verses.kjv: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'What is impossible for people is possible with God.'

verses.kjv: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
verses.decoded: Peter said, 'Look, we have left everything and followed you.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'I tell you the truth, no one who has left home, parents, brothers, wife, or children for the kingdom of God

verses.kjv: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
verses.decoded: will fail to receive many times more in this life, and in the age to come, eternal life.'

verses.kjv: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
verses.decoded: He will be handed over to the Gentiles, and they will make fun of him, treat him badly, and spit on him.

verses.kjv: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.decoded: They will whip him and kill him, but on the third day he will rise again.

verses.kjv: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
verses.decoded: But they did not understand any of this; the meaning was hidden from them, and they did not know what was being said.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
verses.decoded: As Jesus came near Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.

verses.kjv: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
verses.decoded: When he heard the crowd passing by, he asked what was happening.

verses.kjv: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
verses.decoded: They told him, 'Jesus of Nazareth is passing by.'

verses.kjv: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.decoded: He shouted, 'Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!'

verses.kjv: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.decoded: Those walking ahead told him to be quiet, but he shouted even louder, 'Son of David, have mercy on me!'

verses.kjv: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
verses.decoded: Jesus stopped and ordered that the man be brought to him. When he came close, Jesus asked him,

verses.kjv: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
verses.decoded: 'What do you want me to do for you?' He said, 'Lord, I want to see again.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Receive your sight; your faith has healed you.'

verses.kjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
verses.decoded: Immediately he could see, and he followed Jesus, praising God. Everyone who saw it praised God too.

verses.kjv: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
verses.decoded: Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
verses.decoded: There was a man named Zacchaeus who was the chief tax collector and was rich.

verses.kjv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
verses.decoded: He wanted to see who Jesus was, but he could not because of the crowd, since he was short.

verses.kjv: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
verses.decoded: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus, because Jesus was going to pass that way.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
verses.decoded: When Jesus reached the spot, he looked up, saw him, and said, 'Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, because today I must stay at your house.'

verses.kjv: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.decoded: Zacchaeus quickly came down and welcomed him happily.

verses.kjv: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
verses.decoded: When the people saw this, they all complained, saying, 'Jesus has gone to be a guest of a sinner.'

verses.kjv: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
verses.decoded: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, 'Look, Lord, I will give half of my possessions to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will pay back four times as much.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, 'Today salvation has come to this house, because he is also a descendant of Abraham.'

verses.kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.decoded: The Son of Man came to seek and save those who are lost.

verses.kjv: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
verses.decoded: While they were listening to this, Jesus told them a story because he was near Jerusalem and they thought God's kingdom would appear right away.

verses.kjv: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.decoded: He said, 'A nobleman went to a distant country to get a kingdom for himself and then return.'

verses.kjv: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
verses.decoded: He called ten servants, gave them ten pounds, and told them, 'Do business with this until I come back.'

verses.kjv: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
verses.decoded: But his citizens hated him and sent a message after him, saying, 'We will not have this man rule over us.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
verses.decoded: When he returned with the kingdom, he ordered the servants to be called to find out how much each had earned by trading.

verses.kjv: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
verses.decoded: The first came and said, 'Lord, your pound has earned ten pounds.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
verses.decoded: He said to him, 'Good servant! Because you were faithful with a little, you will have authority over ten cities.'

verses.kjv: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
verses.decoded: The second came and said, 'Lord, your pound has earned five pounds.'

verses.kjv: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
verses.decoded: He told him, 'You will be in charge of five cities.'

verses.kjv: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
verses.decoded: Another came and said, 'Lord, here is your pound; I kept it safe wrapped in a cloth.'

verses.kjv: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
verses.decoded: I was afraid of you because you are a hard man; you take what you did not put in and gather what you did not plant.'

verses.kjv: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
verses.decoded: He said to him, 'I will judge you by your own words, you wicked servant. You knew I was a hard man, taking what I did not put in and gathering what I did not plant.

verses.kjv: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
verses.decoded: Why then did you not put my money in the bank so I could get it back with interest when I returned?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
verses.decoded: He told those standing by, 'Take the pound from him and give it to the one who has ten pounds.'

verses.kjv: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
verses.decoded: But they said, 'Lord, he already has ten pounds.'

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'I tell you, everyone who has will be given more; but from the one who has nothing, even what they have will be taken away.'

verses.kjv: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
verses.decoded: But bring here those enemies of mine who did not want me to be king over them, and kill them in front of me.'

verses.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: After saying this, Jesus went ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.decoded: When he came near Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

verses.kjv: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
verses.decoded: and said, 'Go to the village ahead of you. When you enter, you will find a young donkey tied there that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.'

verses.kjv: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
verses.decoded: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you untying him?' say, 'The Lord needs him.'

verses.kjv: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
verses.decoded: The men who were sent went and found everything just as Jesus had told them.

verses.kjv: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
verses.decoded: While they were untying the young donkey, its owners asked, 'Why are you untying the donkey?'

verses.kjv: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
verses.decoded: They answered, 'The Lord needs it.'

verses.kjv: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
verses.decoded: They brought the donkey to Jesus, threw their clothes on it, and placed Jesus on it.

verses.kjv: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
verses.decoded: As he went along, people spread their clothes on the road.

verses.kjv: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
verses.decoded: When Jesus came near the place where the road goes down from the Mount of Olives, the whole group of disciples began to be very happy and praised God loudly for all the miracles they had seen.

verses.kjv: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
verses.decoded: They said, 'Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!'

verses.kjv: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
verses.decoded: Some Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, 'Teacher, tell your disciples to stop.'

verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'I tell you, if they keep quiet, the stones will immediately shout out.'

verses.kjv: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
verses.decoded: When Jesus came near the city, he looked at it and cried.

verses.kjv: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
verses.decoded: He said, 'If only you had understood, even you, especially today, what would bring you peace! But now these things are hidden from your eyes.'

verses.kjv: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
verses.decoded: The time will come when your enemies will surround you with a trench and attack you from every side.

verses.kjv: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
verses.decoded: They will destroy you and your children inside you; they will leave not one stone on another because you did not recognize the time when God came to help you.

verses.kjv: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
verses.decoded: Jesus entered the temple and began driving out those who were selling and buying there.

verses.kjv: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.decoded: He said to them, 'It is written, My house is a house of prayer, but you have made it a den of thieves.'

verses.kjv: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
verses.decoded: Jesus taught every day in the temple. But the leading priests, the teachers of the law, and the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.

verses.kjv: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
verses.decoded: But they could not find a way to do it because all the people were listening closely to him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
verses.decoded: One day, while Jesus was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the good news, the leading priests, teachers of the law, and elders came to him.

verses.kjv: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'By what authority are you doing these things? Who gave you this authority?'

verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
verses.decoded: Jesus answered them, 'I will ask you one question. Answer me:'

verses.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
verses.decoded: Was John's baptism from heaven or from people?

verses.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
verses.decoded: They discussed this among themselves, saying, 'If we say it was from heaven, he will ask, Why didn’t you believe him?'

verses.kjv: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
verses.decoded: But if we say it was from people, the crowd will stone us, because they are convinced John was a prophet.

verses.kjv: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
verses.decoded: So they answered, 'We don’t know where it was from.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Then I won’t tell you by what authority I do these things.'

verses.kjv: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
verses.decoded: Then Jesus told the people this story: A man planted a vineyard, rented it to some farmers, and went away for a long time.

verses.kjv: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.decoded: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the farmers to get some of the fruit from the vineyard, but the farmers beat the servant and sent him away empty-handed.

verses.kjv: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
verses.decoded: He sent another servant, but they also beat him, treated him badly, and sent him away empty-handed.

verses.kjv: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
verses.decoded: He sent a third servant, and they wounded him and threw him out.

verses.kjv: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
verses.decoded: The owner of the vineyard said, 'What should I do? I will send my beloved son. Maybe they will respect him when they see him.'

verses.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be our's.
verses.decoded: But when the farmers saw the son, they talked among themselves, 'This is the heir. Let’s kill him so the inheritance will be ours.'

verses.kjv: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
verses.decoded: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What will the owner of the vineyard do to those farmers?

verses.kjv: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
verses.decoded: He will come and destroy those farmers and give the vineyard to others.' When the people heard this, they said, 'No, that must not happen!'

verses.kjv: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
verses.decoded: Jesus looked at them and said, 'What does this mean: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone?'

verses.kjv: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.decoded: Anyone who falls on that stone will be broken, but anyone it falls on will be crushed.

verses.kjv: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
verses.decoded: At that moment, the leading priests and teachers of the law wanted to arrest Jesus, but they were afraid of the people because they knew the story was about them.

verses.kjv: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
verses.decoded: So they watched him closely and sent spies who pretended to be honest people to catch him saying something wrong so they could hand him over to the governor’s authority.

verses.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'Teacher, we know you speak and teach the truth and don’t show favoritism, but teach the way of God honestly.

verses.kjv: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
verses.decoded: Is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?'

verses.kjv: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
verses.decoded: Jesus saw their trick and said, 'Why are you trying to trap me?'

verses.kjv: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
verses.decoded: He asked them, 'Show me a coin. Whose picture and name are on it?' They answered, 'Caesar’s.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God.'

verses.kjv: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
verses.decoded: They couldn’t trap him with his words in front of the people, and they were amazed by his answer and stayed silent.

verses.kjv: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
verses.decoded: Then some Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and asked him,

verses.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.decoded: 'Teacher, Moses wrote that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the brother should marry the widow and have children for his brother.'

verses.kjv: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
verses.decoded: There were seven brothers. The first married a woman and died without children.

verses.kjv: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
verses.decoded: The second brother married her and died without children.

verses.kjv: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
verses.decoded: The third brother did the same, and so did all seven. They left no children and died.

verses.kjv: Last of all the woman died also.
verses.decoded: Finally, the woman also died.

verses.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
verses.decoded: So at the resurrection, whose wife will she be? All seven had her as their wife.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
verses.decoded: Jesus answered them, 'People of this world marry and are given in marriage.'

verses.kjv: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
verses.decoded: But those who are considered worthy to receive that world and the resurrection from the dead do not marry or are given in marriage.

verses.kjv: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
verses.decoded: They can no longer die, because they are like angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

verses.kjv: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
verses.decoded: Now about the fact that the dead are raised, even Moses showed this at the burning bush when he called the Lord the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.kjv: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
verses.decoded: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, because all are alive to him.

verses.kjv: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
verses.decoded: Then some of the teachers of the law said, 'Teacher, you have spoken well.'

verses.kjv: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
verses.decoded: After that, they did not dare to ask him any more questions.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?
verses.decoded: Then he said to them, 'How do they say that the Messiah is the son of David?'

verses.kjv: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.decoded: David himself says in the book of Psalms, 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand,'

verses.kjv: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.decoded: 'Until I make your enemies your footstool.'

verses.kjv: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
verses.decoded: So David calls him Lord; how can he then be his son?

verses.kjv: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
verses.decoded: Then, speaking to his disciples in front of all the people, he said,

verses.kjv: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
verses.decoded: 'Be careful of the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in long robes, enjoy being greeted in the marketplaces,

verses.kjv: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
verses.decoded: and want the best seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.

verses.kjv: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.decoded: Now the time for the Feast of Unleavened Bread was coming, which is also called the Passover.

verses.kjv: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
verses.decoded: He also saw a poor widow putting in two small coins.

verses.kjv: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
verses.decoded: He said, 'I tell you the truth, this poor widow has given more than all of them.'

verses.kjv: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
verses.decoded: All of them gave from their surplus, but she gave everything she had to live on.

verses.kjv: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
verses.decoded: Some were talking about the temple and how beautiful it was with its stones and gifts, and he said,

verses.kjv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.decoded: 'The time will come when not one stone will be left on another; everything will be destroyed.'

verses.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
verses.decoded: They asked him, 'Teacher, when will this happen? What will be the sign that it is about to happen?'

verses.kjv: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Be careful not to be fooled, because many will come in my name, saying, I am the Messiah, and the time is near. Don't follow them.'

verses.kjv: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
verses.decoded: When you hear about wars and riots, don't be afraid. These things must happen first, but the end will not come immediately.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
verses.decoded: Then he said to them, 'Nation will fight against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.'

verses.kjv: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
verses.decoded: There will be great earthquakes in many places, famines, and diseases. Terrible things and great signs will come from heaven.

verses.kjv: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
verses.decoded: This will give you a chance to tell about me.

verses.kjv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.decoded: Decide now not to worry about how you will defend yourselves.

verses.kjv: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
verses.decoded: I will give you the right words and wisdom that none of your enemies will be able to argue against or resist.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.decoded: You will be betrayed by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. Some of you will be killed.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
verses.decoded: Everyone will hate you because of me.
